sourceTitle: 即将开战！鲁汶学联 Laser Tag 激光对战活动报名开启！
evidence: The article explicitly gives 2026-10-17, 14:00–15:15, including check-in from 14:00.
The registration form was opened read-only and confirms the event, price, subsidy, capacity and form-plus-payment requirement.
The form labels its deadline CET while October 13 is in Brussels summer time; public copy preserves 23:59 without inventing a timezone clarification.
The recap confirms the activity began at 14:00 on 2026-10-17 at LASER3000, with 28 participants divided into two batches, each split into two opposing teams.
The recap describes the rules briefing, instructional video, laser guns, illuminated red/green vests, and Tactical Team Mode with teamwork among obstacles and cover.

The original announcement planned an end time of 15:15. The recap does not confirm the actual end time, so endDate is omitted from the public recap while the original planned endDate is retained in this internal record.

The recap replaces the registration announcement on the same event key and route. Public registration URL, fees, payment account, capacity, match schedule and advance-arrival/cancellation instructions have been removed. The actual turnout of 28 is not the former capacity of 32.
Original announcement details and registration metadata retained above are historical source evidence, not current registration instructions.

images.note: Archived original announcement promotional banner, retained byte for byte but no longer used as the public event cover.
Cover: participants gathering and chatting in the LASER3000 corridor, not a photograph of gameplay. Byte-for-byte copy of the locally saved WebP image; original CSAL watermark retained.
Gallery: LASER3000 venue entrance, not a photograph of gameplay. Byte-for-byte copy of the locally saved WebP image; original CSAL watermark retained.

excludedImages: Original announcement: decorative separators, two unavailable lazy-loaded venue graphics, and an unavailable registration QR. Recap: source indices 0, 3 and 9 are decorative; indices 4–8 are unavailable lazy-loaded photographs. No missing image was reconstructed or substituted. No WeChat original-post link is rendered publicly.
